deploybot: Release redwood-api@v2.14.0 -> prod started (commit `abc1234`). Migrations kicked: `2026_add_user_email_index` job=mg-4821. Change window 2026-03-20 01:00-03:00 UTC. Canary: staging passed. Logs: https://ci/internal/123

mike: ack, watching. tagging @oncall

jessica: noted. ping if migration > 10m. what's expected runtime?

sara: DB team estimated ~6-8 min on main shard; indexing may be long tail on replicas.

deploybot: mg-4821 heartbeat: 00:02:14, progress 35%, current step `create_index_concurrently`. Recent log:
```
INFO 00:02:13 add_index: started on users(email)
INDEX SCAN 120000 rows
```

david: can we reduce batch_size or pause writes to speed up?

sara: can't pause writes in prod. we can set `maintenance_indexing=true` for a subset, but that increases lock risk. prefer to let run unless impact.

mike: seeing spike in cpu on db-primary, 78% -> 92% in last 30s. i'm leaning to enable read-only fallback for non-critical routes. @jessica any objections?

jessica: ok for read-only on /search and /suggest, but keep write paths for signups. rolling flag `release/2026-03-20/readonly` created.

deploybot: mg-4821 update: 00:07:12 progress 79%, step `validate_index`, ETA ~2m.

oncall-bot: #incident-detect cpu > 85% on db-primary for 4 mins. alerting channel.

sara: if it finishes within 5m prefer to let it finish. if not, prepare rollback plan: rollback tag -> redwood-api@v2.13.9 and revert migration by running `db:rollback --to 2026_pre_mig`.

mike: agreed. prepping rollback script in `ops/rollback/1872345678.sh`

deploybot: mg-4821 finished: SUCCESS in 00:09:01. Index added to users(email). Canary checks PASS. Post-migration validation: sample reads ok, no errors in app logs.

jessica: nice. confirming we keep prod live and will revert read-only flags.

mike: removing `release/2026-03-20/readonly` now.

deploybot: release redwood-api@v2.14.0 -> prod COMPLETE (commit `abc1234`). Deployed at 2026-03-20T01:09:38Z.

david: :thumbsup:

sara: leaving note for postmortem: monitor slow queries over next 24h, tag `mig-4821` in logs.

oncall-bot: scheduled post-deploy check at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z
